cues.en: Instructor: This video is an unsupervised learning challenge, and it's a little bit different from most of the unsupervised learning challenges in this course, because I'm not actually going to ask you
cues.zh: 這部影片是「非監督式學習」挑戰，和大部分挑戰稍有不同，因為其實不要求你，

cues.en: to write a lot of code.
cues.zh: 寫很多程式。

cues.en: Instead, I'm gonna ask you to think about something, and it may seem a little bit weird at first, but I hope you will eventually come to the right answer.
cues.zh: 而是要思考一件事。一開始可能有點奇怪，但希望最後能找到正確答案。

cues.en: Okay, so this is the code from the previous video.
cues.zh: 這是前一部影片的程式碼。

cues.en: So here we created this analytic Gaussian distribution, this normal distribution, and obviously it looks like a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡建立解析高斯、常態分布，顯然看起來就是常態分布。

cues.en: And then here in the next cell, what we did was create random numbers that have a Gaussian distribution and then we made a histogram.
cues.zh: 下一個儲存格，建立服從高斯分布的隨機數，再畫直方圖。

cues.en: And then you see that the histogram looks a bit like the analytic distribution.
cues.zh: 可以看到，直方圖看起來有點像解析分布。

cues.en: So this is a histogram of sampled random noise.
cues.zh: 這是抽樣隨機雜訊的直方圖。

cues.en: And this is the analytic distribution.
cues.zh: 這是解析分布。

cues.en: Now this was created from the histogram function, and this was created from a plot function after applying a formula.
cues.zh: 這個用histogram函式建立，另一個則套用公式後，用plot函式畫出。

cues.en: Now what I would like to do is plot the histogram of this thing.
cues.zh: 現在要對這個東西，畫直方圖。

cues.en: So this was called variable gaudist.
cues.zh: 這個變數叫gaudist。

cues.en: So I'm going to say the histogram of gaudist.
cues.zh: 所以對gaudist畫直方圖。

cues.en: And let's go with 40 histogram bins.
cues.zh: 使用40個區間。

cues.en: And again, what I'm doing now is taking this variable here, these data here, and creating a histogram.
cues.zh: 再提醒，現在取的是這個變數、這些資料，建立直方圖。

cues.en: And I'm gonna plot that down here.
cues.zh: 把它畫在下面。

cues.en: Hmm, now this doesn't even look remotely like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 嗯，這完全不像高斯。

cues.en: In fact, this is, you know, kind of the inverse of a Gaussian, if anything, that it's really small here and it gets bigger towards the edges.
cues.zh: 如果一定要說，反而像高斯的相反：這裡很小，往兩端變大。

cues.en: So why is this the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: This is your unsupervised learning challenge.
cues.zh: 這就是你的自主學習挑戰。

cues.en: See if you can figure out, make sense outta this.
cues.zh: 看看能不能想通。

cues.en: Why is it that this Gaussian distribution, when I make the histogram of this plot, it looks totally, totally non-Gaussian.
cues.zh: 為什麼這個高斯分布，對它的圖再畫直方圖，結果卻完全、完全不是高斯？

cues.en: What in the world is going on here?
cues.zh: 到底發生什麼事？
